acceptanceBlockers.missing: Required immune-peer independent agency and its death/interruption branch depend on the still-pending Timeless Form complete lifecycle. Native immunity text alone supplies no accepted full actor/clock procedure.

acceptanceBlockers.minimalCorrection: Authorize and demonstrate a finite local guarantee mechanism with complete adversarial closure, or explicitly qualify the native unconditional promise. No automatic fulfillment, invulnerability or global veto is invented.
acceptanceBlockers.missing: Two lawful delivery routes and saved pending obligations are demonstrated, but no source-qualified finite mechanism guarantees the native MUST event when all routes/intervention stay suppressed/obstructed or protected external facts defeat the item/destination through deadline.

acceptanceBlockers.minimalCorrection: After a source-complete guarantee is available, bind its actual creation/payment/fulfillment and demonstrate compatible and conflicting past transactions, current release-time versions and all affected actual histories. Keep unknown material/body/soul branches held.

The proposal can reject changing a conditional prophecy creation record, but that is not evidence against a source-complete guaranteed obligation. Actual consumed-material and death/Hunt history branches also retain exact missing-data holds.

acceptanceBlockers.minimalCorrection: Bind the complete guarantee and exact external/parent history closure; demonstrate one compatible full future and rejected incompatible future with all original payments, clocks and objective predicates preserved.

scopeQualifications.BALANCE: No balance approval or quantitative balance validation.
scopeQualifications.COMPLETION: Six proposals do not assert whole rule review/engine/game completion. Pending held identities and future obligations remain open.
scopeQualifications.COSMOLOGY: No new soul/Hunt/finality, planar or cosmology authority; a400day calendar year is not a primordial epoch.
scopeQualifications.DOMAIN: No time/causality, spell domain or whole-game domain closure.
scopeQualifications.PHYSICAL: Actors, body/hand/focus, geometry, support, cargo, custody, witnesses and campaign facts in traces are explicit conditional scenario operands, not authenticated campaign data.
scopeQualifications.PLAY: No human playtest or live campaign execution occurred.
scopeQualifications.RELEASE: No shipping, release or selectable-runtime authorization; canonical application reserved to the owner.
scopeQualifications.RUNTIME: No game or supplied/historical program executed. JSON replay is static evidence, not engine implementation or runtime approval.
scopeQualifications.SOURCE: Exact native cards, all access rows, acquisition, authoritative snapshots and source permissions remain controlling; no later backing-source change becomes accepted without matching evidence.
